title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker leading the Agency investigation who traps Anzrag and follows a message to Karlov Cathedral.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young Agency investigator who shows Kaya his projektor and fights Anzrag.

entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: A Gruul harvest god in the form of a giant star-nosed mole, who escapes the evidence locker and wrecks Agency headquarters.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The archon head of the Agency who challenges Anzrag and orders Yarus brought in.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A ghost Boros investigator who goes alone to Rix Maadi and is trapped in a crystal skull by Judith.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: An Agency detective who takes Etrata to Golgari territory and ends the story claiming to know who is responsible.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir assassin now working with Proft who wakes him when he is knocked out.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: A Golgari elf in spider-mask paint who analyzes the powder.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: The Rakdos figure who traps Agrus Kos in a crystal skull and plots to take over her guild by framing Rakdos.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A demon who sleeps in a lava pit beneath Rix Maadi, covered in dust and blood-red moss.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros leader who declares war on the Rakdos when Agrus Kos goes missing.

entities.name: Delney
entities.description: A guildless youth who delivers a message to Kaya.

entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: A Gruul figure Ezrim suspects of freeing Anzrag.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The murdered Orzhov leader.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: The murdered Simic leader.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya dryad Kellan wonders about.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city-plane.

entities.name: Agency headquarters
entities.description: The Agency's building, wrecked by Anzrag.

entities.name: Sixth Precinct
entities.description: A Golgari warren under the city.

entities.name: Korozda
entities.description: A Golgari site that rose to the surface and reshaped the warrens.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: The Rakdos guildhall above the lava pit where Rakdos sleeps.

entities.name: Karlov Cathedral
entities.description: The Orzhov funeral cathedral where Kaya meets Proft and Etrata.

entities.name: Projektor
entities.description: A brass Agency device that displays notes and sketches, edited with a mizzium-tipped stylus.

entities.name: Crystal skull
entities.description: Judith's skull in which she imprisons Agrus Kos's spirit.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The independent investigators led by Ezrim.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The enforcement guild Aurelia leads.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The guild of the demon Rakdos.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild of the undercity, hiding since the invasion.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The guild that worships Anzrag.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose note Kaya found and whose return Proft fears.

entities.name: Phyrexian note
entities.description: A note in Teysa's hand written in Phyrexian that Kaya found at the scene.

entities.name: Mind palace
entities.description: Proft's blue-white mental construct where a hooded figure steals a file.

events.summary: Kellan shows Kaya his projektor and they review the evidence, doubting that Rakdos is behind the murders.
events.quote: I don't think Rakdos is behind this

events.summary: An alarm announces that the evidence locker has been compromised.
events.quote: Someone's compromised the evidence locker!

events.summary: The evidence room lies in ruins as Anzrag breaks free.
events.quote: The room containing the evidence locker lay in ruins, the walls completely shattered by the force of whatever had been released.

events.summary: Anzrag emerges from the dust and smashes an agent flat.
events.quote: the smoke parted as its occupant lunged forward, massive, spatulate front paws slamming into the floor.

events.summary: Kellan identifies the creature as the Gruul harvest god Anzrag.
events.quote: The Gruul call him Anzrag

events.summary: Several agents are killed or injured as Anzrag rampages and Kaya leaps onto him.
events.quote: At least four people were down, two buried under chunks of masonry, one flattened by the god, and one sliced nearly in two by her claws.

events.summary: Kaya stabs Anzrag's nose while Kellan slashes his forelegs.
events.quote: Kaya struck him square in the middle of the tendril starburst, daggers biting deep.

events.summary: Ezrim challenges Anzrag while Kaya plans to use an evidence capsule.
events.quote: Ezrim was standing in the open space between the agent desks and the evidence pen

events.summary: Kaya phases through Anzrag's blow and traps him in the capsule.
events.quote: The capsule chimed, an incongruously pleasant sound, before expanding into a massive bubble, trapping Anzrag inside.

events.summary: Ezrim orders agents to fetch Yarus, whom he blames for the breakout.
events.quote: Find Yarus and bring him back here. I know he had something to do with this.

events.summary: Agrus Kos tells Kaya he must investigate alone, because it is too dangerous for a living person.
events.quote: this is too dangerous for a living person

events.summary: Proft leads Etrata down into Golgari territory, explaining that Korozda's rise reshaped the warrens.
events.quote: When Korozda rose to the surface, it changed the shape of the warrens below.

events.summary: Proft and Etrata meet Izoni in the ruins of an old guildhall.
events.quote: I would never have found you if you hadn't allowed it, Izoni

events.summary: Izoni analyzes the powder and says it is natural and biological but unknown on Ravnica.
events.quote: This is natural. Biological, at the very least.

events.summary: Izoni says the Swarm hides because of something not of Ravnica, and Proft fears the invaders have changed tactics.
events.quote: We may not have won as decisively as we all want to believe.

events.summary: Proft chases a hooded figure and is struck unconscious.
events.quote: fell as something slammed into the side of his head with force enough to take the rest of the world away.

events.summary: Agrus Kos descends to Rakdos's lava pit and finds the demon asleep under dust and moss.
events.quote: Rakdos lay curled at the burning center of the lava, eyes closed, seeming oddly peaceful.

events.summary: Judith captures Agrus Kos in a crystal skull.
events.quote: Judith stepped out of the shadows, a crystal skull in her hands, smirking at the place where he had been.

events.summary: Judith reveals she is planting clues to frame Rakdos and take over the guild.
events.quote: All I need to do is throw enough clues in front of those amateur crime-chasers, and this ends with me at center stage.

events.summary: In Proft's mind palace a hooded figure rifles through his files.
events.quote: A figure in a long, hooded cloak was rummaging through one of his drawers, looking at the files inside.

events.summary: The hooded figure says Ravnica is only a waypoint and takes a folder.
events.quote: Ravnica is a waypoint, not the destination.

events.summary: Etrata strikes Proft awake after he fell into a trance.
events.quote: I hit you when you wouldn't wake up

events.summary: Aurelia storms in and declares the Boros Legion at war with the Rakdos Cult.
events.quote: The Boros Legion marches to war.

events.summary: Delney delivers a note telling Kaya to meet at Karlov Cathedral alone.
events.quote: Meet at Karlov Cathedral. Come alone.

events.summary: Kaya arrives at Karlov Cathedral, prepared for Teysa's funeral.
events.quote: Kaya's carriage let her off in front of a cathedral dressed to the nines

events.summary: Proft and Etrata reveal they summoned Kaya.
events.quote: It's fine, Etrata. We invited her.

events.summary: Proft tells Kaya the killers are controlled by an outside force.
events.quote: The killers are being controlled by an outside force.

events.summary: Kaya confesses she found a Phyrexian-script note on Teysa's body.
events.quote: A note, in her own hand, but not her own language. It was written in Phyrexian.

events.summary: Proft announces he knows who is responsible and asks Kaya to arrange a gathering.
events.quote: I know who's responsible for this

relations.note: imprisons his spirit in a crystal skull
relations.quote: Judith stepped out of the shadows, a crystal skull in her hands

relations.note: ostensibly serves the sleeping demon while plotting against him
relations.quote: leaving the demon she ostensibly served to slumber.
No one rose as high in their guild as Izoni had without some degree of pride.
It's fine, Etrata. We invited her.
The Boros Legion marches to war.
Ezrim had arranged for the removal of the fallen Agency detectives
